title: Automated Enrichment Analysis with GraphRAG: Efficient Multi-Database ORA Extraction and Biological Interpretation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Over-representation analysis (ORA) is widely used to interpret gene-expression studies, but its outputs are often fragmented across gene-set databases and presented as flat term lists that obscure gene-level links among related enrichment signals. We propose Graph-Based Over-Representation Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GBOR-RAG), an integrated and traceable framework for ORA interpretation. GBOR-RAG represents heterogeneous gene-set databases as a unified term--gene knowledge graph, where shared genes connect related terms across sources. After graph-based ORA scoring, the framework retrieves a compact connected evidence subgraph that preserves both cross-database relationships and gene-level support. The subgraph conditions an LLM to generate biological interpretations, and we introduce a claim-level faithfulness metric to assess whether generated claims are supported by explicit evidence. translated_abstract: 过度表示分析（ORA）被广泛用于解读基因表达研究，但其结果往往分散在多个基因集数据库中，并以扁平的术语列表形式呈现，掩盖了相关富集信号之间的基因层面联系。我们提出了基于图的过度表示检索增强生成（GBOR-RAG），这是一个用于ORA解读的集成且可追溯的框架。GBOR-RAG将异构的基因集数据库表示为统一的术语-基因知识图谱，其中共享的基因将来自不同来源的相关术语连接起来。在基于图的ORA评分之后，该框架检索出一个紧凑的连通证据子图，该子图同时保留了跨数据库关系和基因层面的支持。该子图作为大语言模型（LLM）的条件输入以生成生物学解释，并且我们引入了一个声明级忠实度指标来评估生成的声明是否有明确证据支持。实验表明，基于图的ORA保留了……
tldr: 提出GBOR-RAG框架，将多个异构基因集数据库统一为术语-基因知识图谱，通过检索证据子图条件化大语言模型生成可追溯的生物学富集解释，并引入声明级忠实度指标评估生成内容的证据支持。
en_tdlr: Proposes GBOR-RAG, a framework that unifies heterogeneous gene-set databases into a term-gene knowledge graph and retrieves compact evidence subgraphs to condition LLMs for traceable biological interpretation of over-representation analysis, introducing a claim-level faithfulness metric to verify evidence-grounded outputs.
